hero.title: The highlands that give, and the hands that give back.
hero.subtitle: How more than 15 years of trading Indonesian coffee became Given Coffee — a certified exporter built on traceability and trust.

story.title: Coffee is the reason we met.
story.body: Given Coffee grew out of a simple frustration shared by the people who know Indonesian coffee best: too often, great beans were exported in bulk, blended, and sold without a name — and the farmers who grew them were invisible.
story.body2: We set out to change that. For more than 15 years we have worked as a licensed PT exporter, partnering with family farms across the Indonesian highlands, buying their harvest directly and paying fairly. We combine lots by variety so every container is consistent — then bring each one to the world with its origin intact. That is the 'given' in our name: what the land gives us, we give forward.

origin.title: Sourced from the Indonesian highlands
origin.body: We source green beans from partner farms in the Indonesian highlands — regions known for their volcanic soil, cool nights and densely-flavoured coffee. Lots are combined from several farms with the same variety, giving buyers a consistent, traceable product. Full technical data (altitude, variety, processing, cupping and moisture) is available on request for each lot.

sustainability.title: Certified, traceable, export-ready
sustainability.body: Given Coffee operates as a licensed PT exporter with NIB and Halal certification. We pay at harvest time, support farm-gate pricing, and reinvest part of every sale into the farming communities we buy from. Each shipment is documented end to end — so buyers know exactly what they're receiving and where it came from.

quote.text: We don't sell anonymous beans. We sell the work of people who wake before sunrise to grow something honest — and we make sure the world knows their name.

items.q: How can I request green bean samples?
items.a: Use the inquiry form above or contact us on WhatsApp — we'll arrange a sample lot so you can evaluate the origin before ordering.

items.q: What are the minimum order quantities (MOQ) for LCL and FCL shipments?
items.a: Private label orders start at 2 tonnes. For LCL and FCL quantities, tell us your market and volume and we'll confirm the arrangement that fits.

items.q: What payment terms and Incoterms do you support (FOB, CIF, T/T, L/C)?
items.a: We support common Incoterms such as FOB and CIF, with payment terms (T/T, L/C, and others) confirmed per order.

items.q: Can you provide custom processing or private label roasting?
items.a: We specialise in green bean export. Private label packaging is available from a 2-tonne MOQ; for roasting, we can connect you with suitable partners.

items.q: What export documentation do you provide with each shipment?
items.a: Each shipment ships with the required export documentation, including our NIB and Halal certificates. The full documentation list for your destination is confirmed per order.
